scientific.purpose: Select GeoBC solver empirically across all three Transolver versions, FNO and MLP; separate longer exposure from larger CAD coverage without preselecting Hash/FNO/Transolver
scientific.dataset: original DeepJEB v1.0 CSV signed uXYZ [mm] and signed source scalar stress [MPa]; GRID coordinates aligned to H5 vertices

selection.method: Ascending SHA256 of exact UTF8 prefix+CAD; first160 TRAIN augmentation, next20 DEV; no target/difficulty/download-response selection

recipe.learning_rate_schedule: constant; existing shared recipe retained to isolate exposure and coverage
recipe.loss: All original case nodes, encoded4 MSE; one full-case mean and one Adam update; weighted chunks only for pointwise models; whole global context for transformer
recipe.case_order: For each scale, independent complete shuffles of its full CAD×known3 list using Python Random(2026); identical stored order across all five methods at that scale; 4800 always full passes
recipe.budget_clock: Accumulated whole-case update wall time including case IO and synchronized forward/backward/Adam; excludes separate initialization, evaluation and checkpoint writes which are separately reported
recipe.budget_stop_rule: Check only between complete-case updates, retain partial pass and actual exposures. If 4800 not reached, terminal incomplete_cost_limit, never equate insufficient exposure with converged architecture failure
recipe.second_seed: not part of this macro comparison; no variance/significance claim
recipe.capacity: Reuse exact existing family constructors/presets; capacities differ and are disclosed. This measures current recipe, not tuned family optima
recipe.fno_query: Trilinearly query encoded4 at all original nodes, then physical decode; grid contains inputs only
recipe.transolver_pp_evaluation: Pinned upstream stochastic Gumbel behavior; deterministic per-case checkpoint-specific isolated RNG; preserve train RNG
recipe.continuous_query_scope: Original-node U/S primary; this stage alone does not certify arbitrary interior query/gradient quality or full engineering qualification

scaler.transform: asinh signed S before channel mean/std; inverse only after encoded field query
scaler.fit: Frozen original TRAIN40 × known3 original nodes ONLY; reused for both scales; no fit on added data or DEV

inputs.schema: Reuse current project25 actual material/support/load feature formulas, not a recovered missing slides schema
inputs.cloud: Canonical target-free quadratic boundary xyz cloud1024 with BLAKE2b CAD+seed2026, same PointNet global32
inputs.geometry: H5 vertices/tetra connectivity and actual SolverDeck material/constraints/load; no H5 nodal variables
inputs.new_DEV_prebarrier: CSV GRID and three coordinate columns only; no U/S/strain/dia parse

metrics: case-mean and worst full-node U-vector relative L2
case-mean and worst signed-S relative L2
S RMSE and max absolute error [MPa]
training and warmed/full-node inference wall time and peak GPU memory
primary_readout.ranking: Report separate U/S/worst/hotspot and actual cost; use equal-weight mean of U mean and S mean only as a concise fixed-endpoint screening score, never hide failures
primary_readout.missing_or_failed_case: Keep denominator60 and explicit null/failed metadata; candidate cannot receive all-case complete score/pass
primary_readout.zero_GT_norm: null/undefined plus absolute metrics, never fake 0 or drop case

prediction_barrier.policy: Persist every predeclared checkpoint fullN encoded/physical4 prediction OR explicit terminal failure entry for every frozen arm/checkpoint/DEVcase; commit immutable inventory before shared new_DEV field parse. No further training or endpoint changes after readout in this stage. Actual compatibility failures keep names and denominator; do not replace IDs

coverage_advancement_gate.meaning: Prioritize family with meaningful coverage gains and best physical endpoint/cost, not engineering acceptance

absolute_complete_GeoBC_gate.signed_S_semantics: Direct original signed source scalar supervised as-is; native physical tensor proxy never substituted
absolute_complete_GeoBC_gate.next: Consolidate actual winner/limitations, then design one justified structural or continuous-query step; no automatic Hash micro-tuning or endless width/seed sweep

stop_rules: If frozen raw/input delivery cannot complete, readiness negative with original missing IDs, no substitutions
At cost limit preserve incomplete endpoint/cost, do not rescue budgets or call convergence
A finite negative macro result closes this recipe; no automatic more epochs/data or scalar-formula trials

budgets.overshoot: Existing in-flight chunks/requests may exceed nominal ceiling; actual bytes and wall reported, stop issuing new tasks once exceeded

acquisition.receipt: First observed bytes/SHA with official indexed URL, not upstream checksum or proof of HF bit identity
acquisition.resume: Verified completed-file reuse; incomplete files may restart, no claim of HTTP byte-range resume

estimates.scope: Planning estimates only; actual new node counts, IO, quota and stability unknown; no current completion ETA

execution_pipeline.bootstrap: Only original TRAIN40/120 records and frozen scaler metadata; explicit train40_only, never full660 complete
